κ = 0.00162536523418317, conditional on the inherited framework.

Independent fresh replay of PR610 at immutable commit `d9dc50b46b20cb8f769dd85a851f8b31b0f8f695`: 41/41 top-level stages plus nine nested baseline stages passed in 488.92 seconds, with no reused local or baseline outputs. Conservative κ = 0.001625365231365566. This certifies the existing jp8×71/ck×1 construction (about +0.252% over independently replayed PR604); it introduces no new scalar construction.

The audit checks all 36 package blobs against the exact GitHub tree, 50 stage-log hashes and 49 receipt-artifact hashes, scalar words and arbitrary dirty restoration, both reflected ledgers, wrappers and phase edges, physical owners, fresh invoice, both exact moment engines, 47 strict outer inequalities per model, and 114 assembly controls. `certificates/pr610-independent-replay/` includes the receipts, complete profile/invoice, provenance hashes and a reusable audit checker.

PR610 advanced afterward to `b7c680ea38b9a25a89fce189bb927b45842362d0`. The inspected diff changes only README, NOTICE and their manifest hashes; code, witnesses and SPEC are unchanged. This replay remains explicitly pinned to `d9dc50b`, not the later manifest.

The PR543 bit circuit is cited/repriced, not rebuilt; ck retains pinned PR571 ancestry. All-size compilation, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic transfer and bit H1–H5 remain conditional. No Lean replay, GitHub CI success, unconditional theorem or practical speedup is claimed.

Credit: PR610/604 by DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5, the hyperplane-end work by jeremykothe2, the pinned PR568/569/571/575/583 packages, and their full inherited contributor lineage and original OpenAI #109 framework. Independent replay, checker and packaging prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. All previously published PR heads remain frozen.
title: κ = 0.00162536523418317: independent exact-head replay of PR610
